objective: Quantify seed variance of the canonical H4 operating point. The held-out D7 table currently reports seed 0 only; per-backbone gains of 2-3% on a single seed cannot support a submission claim.

deviation_from_locked_recipe.rationale: A seed is the only degree of freedom that must vary to estimate run-to-run variance. Changing anything else would make the runs non-comparable to the canonical checkpoint.

unchanged_and_verified_at_launch.checkpoint_selection_rule: best development (D2) fused EPE, identical to seed 0

protocol.implementation: model_design/train_seed.py, a sibling of train.py that reuses its metadata(), verify_sources(), validate_output() and config() unchanged and overrides only the seed field
protocol.evaluation: each resulting checkpoint is evaluated with the frozen support-masked module on SCARED-C D2 and D7 using the unmodified definitive protocol; no threshold, policy or selection rule is re-tuned
protocol.reporting_rule: report mean and standard deviation across seeds 0, 1, 2 plus paired sequence-aware bootstrap confidence intervals; sequences are the resampling unit, never pixels

declared_before_seeing_results.primary_endpoint: held-out D7 macro-sequence EPE gain versus raw, per backbone and pooled
declared_before_seeing_results.success_criterion: none - this is a variance estimate, not a selection experiment. No seed will be chosen or discarded on the basis of its result, and the canonical seed-0 checkpoint remains the reported model.
declared_before_seeing_results.failure_disclosure: if seed variance is large enough to overlap zero gain on any backbone, that is reported as such and the corresponding claim is weakened

prohibited: re-tuning any threshold after seeing the seed results
using D7 for any decision other than the final reported numbers
